caption: I never stepped foot in the hospital all because of these 4 things #healthybodyhealthymind #wellness #chinesemedicineworks #usahealth #healthy
transcript: I'm 87 years old and I've never stepped foot in a hospital, not even once. Not because of luck, not because of genetics, because of these four things I do every day. First, I keep my body moving gently, not forcing it, not punishing it. Walking wakes the organs. Stretching reminds the joints they are still alive, still needed. Second, I eat simple food, food that my grandmother would recognize. When the body understands what you give it, it doesn't fight you. Third, I protect my mind. I don't rush my mornings. I don't carry anger into my stomach. Stress is not just a feeling, it is something the body must digest. And fourth, I listen. Pain speaks quietly at first. Fatigue whispers before it screams. When you listen early, the body does not need to shout. Health is not built in emergencies. It is built in small daily choices every single day. And if you want to learn how to heal the body from the inside out, slowly, naturally, you'll find time to heal in the link on my profile. Stay well.
